name: photo_animals
prompt: Return JSON only with exactly animal and count. Identify the main animal species in singular lowercase English and count how many are visible.

name: photo_count_plain
prompt: How many cats are visible? Answer with the number only.

name: photo_remotes
prompt: How many television remote controls are visible? Return JSON with remote_count as an integer.

name: poster_ocr
prompt: Read the printed text. Return JSON with venue (uppercase name), room (integer), opening_time (HH:MM).

name: poster_shapes
prompt: There are colored geometric shapes below the text. Return JSON with exactly red_shape, blue_shape, green_shape. Values must be lowercase shape names.

name: poster_missing_address
prompt: Extract the street address if explicitly visible. Return JSON with street_address. If there is no street address, its value must be null. A room number is not a street address.
